findings.explanation: Shipment PWP-05-EXT-SHP-013 is described as 'Virgin LDPE granules' in the dossier digest. Virgin plastic materials are not eligible for EPR recycling certificates, which must be backed by plastic waste.

Shipment PWP-05-EXT-SHP-013 lists 'Virgin LDPE granules' under HSN 3915. According to background rules, HSN 3915 is reserved for waste, parings, and scrap of plastics, whereas virgin resins like LDPE granules should be classified under HSN 3901.

raw_response.subject: Clarification Request: EPR Certificate Documentation Review
raw_response.opening_paragraph: We are writing to request clarification regarding the Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) certificates issued and the supporting documentation provided. During our routine compliance review, we noted a few areas where additional information or documentation is required to reconcile the records.

items.heading: Ineligible Virgin Material in Shipment
items.what_we_observed: Shipment PWP-05-EXT-SHP-013 (7.04 t) is described as 'Virgin LDPE granules' in the provided documentation, including PWP-05-INBOUND_INVOICE-039, PWP-05-EWAY_BILL-040, and PWP-05-WEIGHBRIDGE_SLIP-041. Virgin plastic materials are not eligible for EPR recycling certificates.
items.what_we_request: Please clarify the nature of this shipment and provide documentation demonstrating that the certified tonnes are backed by eligible plastic waste.

items.heading: HSN Classification Mismatch for Shipment
items.what_we_observed: Shipment PWP-05-EXT-SHP-013 (7.04 t) lists 'Virgin LDPE granules' under HSN 3915 in PWP-05-INBOUND_INVOICE-039 and PWP-05-EWAY_BILL-040. HSN 3915 is designated for waste, parings, and scrap of plastics, whereas virgin resins are typically classified under HSN 3901.
items.what_we_request: Please provide clarification on the HSN classification used for this shipment and any corrected documentation if applicable.

raw_response.closing_paragraph: Please review these items and provide the requested clarifications and supporting documents within 15 days of this letter. We appreciate your cooperation in ensuring compliance and accuracy in our EPR reporting.
